page_title: FIO 1-0 VER | Fiorentina v Verona 17/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The match has just finished.
90+4' The total number of attempts is 5:18.
90+3' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Verona was in an offside position.
90+2' Filippo Terracciano (Verona) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
90+1' One of the Fiorentina players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
88' Fiorentina are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
86' Vincenzo Italiano decides to make a substitution. Rolando Mandragora will be replaced by Yerry Mina (Fiorentina).
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Michael Folorunsho leaves the pitch and Jordi Mboula (Verona) comes on.
78' 1 - 0 Goal! Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top left corner. It's 1:0.
78' The ball is cleared after Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
78' It's a free kick to Fiorentina, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
76' The manager makes a subsitution with Riccardo Saponara (Verona) coming on for Darko Lazovic.

74' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and produces a low shot that sails towards the middle of a goal. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
73' The Fiorentina players are exchanging some short passes.
73' The number of shots on goal at present is 1:7.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lucas Martinez Quarta trots off the pitch and is replaced by Nikola Milenkovic (Fiorentina).
69' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Verona.
68' Maria Ferrieri Caputi shows a yellow card to Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) for his blatant foul.
65' Verona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
65' Antonin Barak (Fiorentina) picked up a yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
63' Marco Baroni has decided to substitute Tomas Suslov and he is replaced by Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona).
62' Milan Djuric will be replaced by Thomas Henry (Verona).
61' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) fails to deliver a decent free kick and the ball goes out of play.
61' Milan Djuric (Verona) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Maria Ferrieri Caputi blows for a foul.
61' Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
58' Antonin Barak received a sweet pass from Arthur Melo (Fiorentina), but the advance is stopped.
58' Darko Lazovic (Verona) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
56' Verona enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
56' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
54' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
53' Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.

53' Darko Lazovic (Verona) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom right corner, but Pietro Terracciano has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
52' Verona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
46' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Arthur Melo comes on the pitch for Maxime Lopez (Fiorentina).
46' The game is over for M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina). Antonin Barak comes on for the second half.
46' Half-time substitution. Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) is replaced by Christian Kouame.
46' Marco Baroni has made a change at the break. Bruno Amione has come on in place of Giangiacomo Magnani (Verona).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+1' The end of the first half.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Cyril Ngonge (Verona) launches himself at a lofted pass, but his close-range header flies just wide of the left post.
42' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina).
39' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Fiorentina comes to nothing.
38' Verona are ruled offside.
37' Verona earn a corner.
36' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
31' Cyril Ngonge (Verona) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Pietro Terracciano is alert and denies him.

29' Milan Djuric (Verona) looks very eager to impress, does well to beat his man and force a cross into the box, where one of his teammates gets his head on the ball, but it's too easy for the keeper.
27' Darko Lazovic (Verona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
27' Referee Maria Ferrieri Caputi sees the trip by Maxime Lopez (Fiorentina) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
26' M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
26' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
25' Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
23' Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
21' The resulting set piece from Verona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
19' The M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Maria Ferrieri Caputi rules it out for a handball.
18' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
17' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
15' The Fiorentina players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
14' M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) commits a foul and Maria Ferrieri Caputi immediately signals a free kick.
11' Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
10' Maria Ferrieri Caputi interrupts the game. One of the players from Verona won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
9' Verona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
9' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Cyril Ngonge (Verona) inside the box following a slide rule pass. Verona have been awarded a corner kick.
3' Milan Djuric (Verona) doesn't take advantage of the chance to score from the penalty spot. He shoots to the bottom right corner, but Pietro Terracciano leaps out to thwart his effort.
3' Milan Djuric (Verona) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
3' It’s a PENALTY to Verona after the VAR review!
3' Referee Maria Ferrieri Caputi makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
2' Pietro Terracciano (Fiorentina) brings an opponent down and Maria Ferrieri Caputi interrupts the game. The referee gives a penalty kick to Verona!!
2' Pietro Terracciano (Fiorentina) has tested the patience of referee Maria Ferrieri Caputi and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Maria Ferrieri Caputi is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Verona will kick the game off.
